theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A control tower needs absolute clarity. The industrial variation uses Slate and high-contrast status colors to guide immediate action without decorative fluff. It avoids AI-slop gradients in favor of sharp, data-dense aesthetics similar to ShipGen/Fleetbase.

typography.primary_font_usage: Headings, Dashboard big numbers, Main navigation
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, dense UI components, forms
typography.mono_font_usage: Vehicle Plates (MH12AB1234), Rupee Values (₹), Time/Turnaround stats, IDs
rules: Use tracking-tight for all numbers above 24px
Never center-align table data unless it's an icon

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: The Control Room Grid
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense. Use p-4 for cards, p-2 for table cells. gap-4 for grids.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Dark left sidebar (bg-slate-900) with white text. High contrast to content area.

components.cards: Flat white background, 1px solid border (border-slate-200), no shadow. On hover, shadow-sm.
components.tables: Dense rows. Header text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500. Borders between rows.
components.badges: Flat color backgrounds (status.bg) with bold text (status.text) and optional 1px border. rounded-sm.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300.
components.tabs: Underline style or solid sharp toggles. Avoid bubbly pill tabs.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone for Sidebar Nav and Dashboard hero stats. Regular weight for dense tables and standard UI.

image_urls.description: Large cargo ship at a dock. Use as a half-screen background image for the login/auth page with a heavy black/slate overlay (bg-slate-900/60).

module_specific_guidelines.control_tower: Use Bento grid (grid-cols-4). Top row for executive KPIs. Use Recharts for occupancy trends. Emphasize Detention Cost in red.
module_specific_guidelines.yard_map: Must use SVG or pure CSS grid for Zones A-F. Overlays for vehicle dots. Color-coded based on status.
module_specific_guidelines.gate_management: Split screen: QR scan placeholder on left, real-time incoming vehicle table on right.
module_specific_guidelines.virtual_queue: Prioritized table with 'Priority Score' column. High scores highlighted in Warning/Danger colors.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, tabs, form inputs, and interactive map zones. Use kebab-case.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 minimum on all status badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No purple/teal defaults.
Use static JSON data structured for an Indian logistics context (₹ currency, MH14/DL01 plate numbers, local transporter names).
Implement the layout with Shadcn UI but customize borders to 1px solid slate-200 and radii to md (6px).
For the Yard Map, build a responsive 2D overhead view using grid or absolute positioning with clearly labeled zones (A-F).
Ensure the sidebar is dark (bg-slate-900) while the main app area is light (bg-slate-50).
Use Phosphor icons. Install using `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Import and use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body, and IBM Plex Mono for numbers.
